name: Inventory read projection
explanation: Rebuilds, per snapshot, a disposable index of declared technical links and answers reverse uses, feature scope, selected revisions and comparison-relative newness without persisting or inferring anything.

code.note: Indexes only declared links: implementation and review Item pins, System members, data-entity holders, relationship destinations and ERD directory or overlay pins.
Walks uses upward through current owner revisions only and reports depth, cycle and traversal-budget cuts instead of presenting a partial answer as complete.
Answers pin status from the index's own map so building the index stays linear.
Derives a feature's technical scope from its implementation Items through declared pins at each saved revision, never substituting a newer revision.
Selects the exact revisions a read answers about and names the unresolved reasons that filters must never hide.
Classifies identity newness against a named baseline; an unreadable baseline is unknown rather than making everything new.
